name: sim_yinyang_axis7_12_extended_mapping
claim: Axes 7-12 map to distinct, geometrically independent yin-yang features

axis_mapping.Axis 7: dot size = interpenetration depth = coupling strength (grade-1 vector direction)
axis_mapping.Axis 8: S-curve curvature = boundary curvature = local constraint surface (grade-2 bivector)
axis_mapping.Axis 9: 3D rotation of symbol = reference frame choice (grade-2 rotor)
axis_mapping.Axis 11: dot offset = symmetry breaking (grade-1 vector displacement)

pytorch.reason: load-bearing: compute 6 independent measurements on parametrized yin-yang; verify Gram matrix rank via torch.linalg.matrix_rank

pyg.reason: not load-bearing: no GNN needed for this axis independence test

z3.reason: load-bearing: UNSAT proves Axis 7 (interpenetration depth) ≠ Axis 0 (yin/yang binary partition) — they are distinct geometric quantities

cvc5.reason: not used: z3 covers the UNSAT requirement

sympy.reason: load-bearing: symbolic derivatives ∂(axis_7_measure)/∂(axis_8_param) = 0 at neutral point (independence); grayscale derivative check

clifford.reason: load-bearing: each Axis 7-12 corresponds to a distinct grade in Cl(3,0) or scalar parameter; grade-0=scale, grade-1=direction, grade-2=rotation, grade-3=pseudoscalar

geomstats.reason: not load-bearing: SO3 rotation of frame handled by pytorch

e3nn.reason: not load-bearing: SO3 equivariance not the primary claim

rustworkx.reason: load-bearing: 12-node axis graph; edges=coupling; verify Axes 7-12 have low coupling to Axes 0-6 (sparse inter-group edges)

xgi.reason: not load-bearing: hyperedge structure captured by rustworkx for this sim

toponetx.reason: not load-bearing: CW complex not required

gudhi.reason: not load-bearing: TDA not needed for axis independence

axes7_12_gram_matrix_full_rank.detail: Gram matrix of Axes 7-12 measurements has rank 6: all axes are geometrically independent

axes7_12_sufficient_variance.detail: Each Axis 7-12 has sufficient variance in the measurement: diagonal ≥ 0.4

axis8_invariant_when_axis7_varies.detail: Axis 8 (S-curve curvature) is constant when only Axis 7 (dot size) varies

neutral_symmetric_all_deformations_zero.detail: Perfectly symmetric yin-yang has all deformation axes (7,9,11,12) = 0: SO(3) level baseline

axis11_independently_variable.detail: Axis 11 (dot offset) varies independently while all other axes stay fixed

sympy_axis7_independent_of_axis8.detail: ∂(axis7_measure)/∂(axis8_param) = 0: dot size is symbolically independent of S-curve curvature

sympy_axis8_independent_of_axis7.detail: ∂(axis8_measure)/∂(axis7_param) = 0: S-curve curvature is symbolically independent of dot size

sympy_axis12_zero_for_pure_bw.detail: Axis 12 = 0 when gray=0 (pure black/white = classical; no superposition)

z3_axis7_not_axis0.detail: z3 UNSAT: Axis 7 (interpenetration ∈ (0,0.5)) ≠ Axis 0 (binary=1): distinct geometric quantities

clifford_axis_grade_mapping.detail: Axes 7-12 map to distinct Cl(3,0) grades: scale=0, vector=1, rotation=2, pseudoscalar=3

rustworkx_low_intergroup_coupling.detail: Axes 7-12 have sparse coupling to Axes 0-6: at most 2 inter-group edges

rustworkx_axes7_12_internal_structure.detail: Axes 7-12 have at least 2 internal coupling edges (internal structure present)

axis7_varies_axis8_unchanged.detail: Changing dot size (Axis 7) leaves S-curve curvature (Axis 8) unchanged

z3_axis12_zero_for_pure_classical.detail: z3 UNSAT: Axis 12=0 (pure BW) AND Axis 12>0 simultaneously impossible

axis11_offset_not_axis9_rotation.detail: Axis 11 (offset/translation) ≠ Axis 9 (rotation): rotation preserves distance; translation changes it

axis12_zero_pure_classical.detail: Axis 12 = 0 for pure black/white: fully classical regime

axis12_one_maximum_superposition.detail: Axis 12 = 1 for fully gray: maximum superposition/mixture regime

axis7_zero_no_interpenetration.detail: Axis 7 = 0 when dot_radius = 0: no interpenetration = crisp yin/yang partition

clifford_grade0_no_higher_grades.detail: Axis 10 (scale = grade-0): no grade-1/2/3 components in a pure scalar

sympy_axis12_linear_in_gray.detail: Axis 12 measurement is linear in grayscale parameter: ∂f12/∂gray = 1
